h1: Lefroy Brooks bathroom installation in Virginia Water

hero.intro: Lefroy Brooks's brassware is built the opposite way round to most modern taps and shower valves: instead of concealing the pipework, it puts cross-head handles, period-inspired profiles and exposed pipe runs on display. That suits the kind of houses found in Virginia Water — large detached properties, many close to the Wentworth Estate and its golf courses, set on generous plots with long driveways and, in a number of cases, gated or private road access. We install Lefroy Brooks taps, shower valves and sanitaryware across Virginia Water as a fit-only service, setting out every exposed pipe run and bracket to be finished properly rather than hidden.

sections.heading: Built to be seen, not boxed in
sections.body: Lefroy Brooks's traditional-style taps, shower valves and sanitaryware are built around exposed pipework, cross-head handles and period-inspired profiles rather than the concealed, minimal fittings most modern brassware favours. That means the pipe runs, brackets and wall fixings are part of the finished look, not something a tiler can cover up — every joint, bracket and length of pipe stays visible once the room is finished. Getting it right means working out exactly where each run and bracket will sit before first-fix starts, because there's no boxing-in to correct a mistake later.

sections.heading: What we fit from the Lefroy Brooks range in Virginia Water
sections.body: We install Lefroy Brooks exposed shower valves and risers, cross-head basin and bath taps, freestanding bath fillers and traditional sanitaryware as a fit-only service — you buy the pieces, we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag. Because the brassware is on display, we plan the pipe route and bracket positions at first-fix stage with the finished room already in mind, so the valve, riser and handles line up exactly where they'll be seen rather than wherever existing pipework happens to run.

sections.heading: Why Virginia Water's properties give us more room to work with
sections.body: Virginia Water's housing — substantial period houses through to more recent executive-style builds, many on generous plots with long driveways and some on gated or private roads — generally gives us far more flexibility on layout than a terraced property would. Relocating a waste run to accommodate a freestanding bath, or repositioning a shower to make better use of natural light, rarely runs into a structural wall it can't move around. For Lefroy Brooks installations specifically, that flexibility matters: exposed pipework reads better when the bath or shower is positioned where the pipe run can be kept clean and deliberate, rather than squeezed around existing plumbing.

sections.heading: Survey, install, price
sections.body: We start with a £125 paid survey to check the room, existing pipework and waste positions, and confirm how the exposed Lefroy Brooks fittings will be set out before anything is stripped out. Installation then starts from £3,500, covering strip-out, first-fix plumbing, tiling, final fix and snagging. You source the Lefroy Brooks taps, shower valves, sanitaryware, tiles and furniture yourself; our price is for the installation work, not for products.

sections.heading: Arrange a Lefroy Brooks survey in Virginia Water
sections.body: If you're fitting out a bathroom in Virginia Water with Lefroy Brooks brassware, call or WhatsApp 07399 651836 to book a £125 survey. We'll assess the room, talk through how the exposed pipework will be routed and set a clear installation price from £3,500.

faqs.q: Is Install My Bathroom a supplier of Lefroy Brooks products?
faqs.a: No — we're fit-only. You buy your Lefroy Brooks taps, shower valves, sanitaryware, tiles and furniture yourself; we handle strip-out, first-fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging.

faqs.q: Why is exposed pipework brassware more involved to install?
faqs.a: Lefroy Brooks's traditional-style fittings use exposed pipework and cross-head handles rather than concealed fittings, so every pipe run, bracket and wall fixing stays visible once the room is finished and needs to be planned and finished to that standard from first-fix onward.

faqs.q: Can you reposition a shower or bath to make better use of natural light?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Virginia Water's generous plots usually give more flexibility on layout than a terraced property allows, so repositioning a shower or relocating a waste run for a freestanding bath rarely runs into a structural wall it can't move around.

faqs.q: What does a Lefroy Brooks installation cost in Virginia Water?
faqs.a: Installations start from £3,500, following a £125 paid survey, with the final price depending on the scope of strip-out, first-fix, tiling and plumbing involved.

faqs.q: Do you handle access for gated or private roads?
faqs.a: Yes, we coordinate site access as part of the standard survey and installation process for Virginia Water properties on gated or private roads.

faqs.q: What if an existing Lefroy Brooks fitting needs repair rather than full installation?
faqs.a: We take on repairs for high-end homes, minimum £200, with emergency call-outs from £500. We don't do regrouting.

image.heroPrompt: Purpose: hero image for a Lefroy Brooks x Virginia Water bathroom installation page. Subject and action: a cross-head bath filler tap with exposed pipe stem, positioned beside a freestanding bath, captured at the point of final-fix with the tap wiped clean and the surrounding tiling just completed. Setting and work-stage: a spacious period-house bathroom with a long window suggesting a long driveway view, honed travertine tiling freshly laid, no fittings fully styled yet. Composition: wide three-quarter shot showing the bath, tap and a section of travertine wall, generous negative space to one side. Light and materials: warm late-afternoon light through a tall window, unlacquered brass with a natural, slightly uneven patina rather than polished uniform shine, travertine with visible natural pitting. Constraints: no people, no text, no logos, no brand names visible on fixtures, no LED strip lighting, no catalog-symmetrical twin fittings, no single uniform gold wash, no plants or candles as props, no water shown running, varied believable sheen not hyper-gloss.
